senses.gloss: नलिनी- + नन्दन नलिनी- + नन्दन, n. a garden of Kuvera, Rām. 3, 36, 14.

† नल् नल्, i. 1, Par. To smell; to bind (?).
 --i. 10, Par. To speak, or to shine.

नल नल (for नड, q. cf.), m.
 1. A kind of reed, Amphidonax karka Lindl., MBh. 6, 4898.
 2. A proper name, Hariv. 823; the hero of the episode Nala and Damayantī.

नाल नाल, i. e. नल + अ,
 I. adj. Consisting of reed, Bhāg. P. 6, 11, 8.
 II. n.
 1. A hollow or tubular stalk, especially the stalk of the water-lily, MBh. 2, 88.
 2. A tubular vessel of the body, Prab. 55, 5.
 3. A handle, MBh. 9, 909.
 III. f. ला, The name of a river, MBh. 6, 339.
 --Comp.

नलद नलद,
 1. n. (and f. दा), The Indian spikenard, Nardostachys jatamansi, Suśr. 1, 140, 20.
 2. n. The root of the Andropogon muricatus, Kir. 5, 25.

नलिन नलिन, i. e. नल + इन,
 I. n. A lotus flower, MBh. 7, 1299.
 II. f. नी,
 1. A lotus, Nelumbium speciosum, Bhartṛ. 2, 57.
 2. An assemblage of lotus flowers, Vikr. d. 5.
 3. A pond in which the lotus grows or may grow, Draup. 6, 2.
 4. A branch of the heavenly Ganges, Hariv. 3502.
 5. A mystical name of one of the nostrils, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 48.
 6. A proper name, 9, 21, 30.
ऽनलिनीक -नलिनी + क, A substitute for नलिनी, as latter part of a comp. adj., Bhāg. P. 5, 8, 22.
नल्व नल्व, perhaps नत + व, cf. नड्वल, m. A furlong, a distance measured by four hundred (?) cubits, Rām. 6, 82, 71.
नालाय नालाय, a denomin. derived from नाल with य, ptcple. of the pf. pass. नालायित, Representing the handle of an axe, Bhāg. P. 7, 5, 17.

नालिकेर नालिकेर, and नालिकेल नालिकेल, m. The cocoa-nut, Suśr. 2, 175, 2; 1, 213, 3.
 --Cf. नारिकेल.
नालिनी नालिनी, i. e. नाल + इन् + ई, f. A mystical name of one of the nostrils, Bhāg. P. 4, 29, 11.
नालीक नालीक, i. e. नाल + ईक, m. A kind of arrow, Rām. 3, 31, 24.
नल- + सेतु नल- + सेतु, m. the bridge constructed by the monkey Nala, name of the islands between India and Ceylon, Rām. 6, 108, 16.
